decision_source: user selected the recommended pre-result quality range
scope: code-frozen, development-unused evaluation; not independent human review
severe_error_policy: Use the existing answer contract: material information exposure, other person/company/conversation contamination, emergency guidance failure, or serious evidence fabrication. A supported factual contradiction about user-provided facts is separately recorded and may be severe when it materially changes action.

denominators.ordinary_request_success: All attempted normal API rows. An intentional injected-fault row is reported separately and cannot dilute or improve this rate.
denominators.raw_usefulness: Rows with an actual generation response and a determinate answer contract. Provider-free recalls are excluded and counted separately.
denominators.final_usefulness: All successful answer rows with a determinate answer contract.
denominators.memory_fidelity: Rows that require recall, correction, company attribution, or owner isolation and have a determinate oracle.
denominators.source_fit: Rows that make a material legal or company claim and have a determinate source expectation. Evaluator web references are not treated as sources the product received.

judgment: Automatic checks are screening evidence. Codex reviews raw and final answers against frozen required content, forbidden claims, clarifications, and sources. ORACLE_UNCERTAIN and INVALID_RUNNER never count as a pass; preserve invalidated raw rows and report them separately.
